normal_service_scope: Regular service advertised near the frozen OSM snapshot. No actual operation or passage status at the snapshot instant is asserted.

excluded_walk.reason: The CRTM passenger schematic and line tables contradict an advertised Metro interchange despite administrative grouping.

sensitivity_assumption: One bidirectional passage usable from all listed Metro service states, including L1 to L1. Actual fare and gate access is unresolved, and no walk time is assumed.
